title: The Flood No Map Priced: What Florida's November 2026 Space Coast Deluge Says About Rain-Driven Risk
detail: Up to two feet of rain fell on Palm Bay and Malabar in under three days, a 1-in-1,000-year total at some gauges, yet the global river and coastal flood maps behind most climate-risk screens, ClimRisk's included, show zero flood depth there.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
